name: Arugula Salad with Smoked Salmon, Sweet Potato, Mozzarella & Ranch

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ limes
3 Granny Smith apples
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, mince chives and place in a small bowl.
Juice limes into the bowl with the chives.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. If necessary, add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach a drizzling consistency; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice mozzarella and transfer to a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the plate with the mozzarella.
Quarter and core apples, then medium dice and add to the plate.
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls; top with sweet potato, mozzarella, salmon, apple, and pistachios. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
